raw_problem.solution_text:
氢原子超精细结构能量修正公式为

$$
E _ {\mathrm {h f}} ^ {1} = \frac {\mu_ {0} g _ {\mathrm {p}} e ^ {2}}{3 \pi m _ {\mathrm {p}} m _ {\mathrm {e}} a ^ {3}} \left\langle \mathbf {S} _ {\mathrm {p}} \cdot \mathbf {S} _ {\mathrm {e}} \right\rangle ,
$$

其中 $a = { \frac { h ^ { 2 } } { \mu \mathrm { e } ^ { 2 } } } , \mu = { \frac { m _ { \mathrm { e } } m _ { \mathrm { p } } } { m _ { \mathrm { e } } + m _ { \mathrm { p } } } }$ 兰， μ= memp 姐原子中电子的约化质量

三重态与单态能量差为(方程 (7.9η $\Delta E = 5 . 8 8 \times 1 0 ^ { - 6 } ~ \mathrm { e V } .$

$\mu$ 子氢 $g$ 因子不变，做代换 $m _ { \mathrm { e } }  m _ { \mu } = 2 0 7 m _ { \mathrm { e } } , a  a _ { \mu } ,$

$$
\begin{array}{l} \frac {a}{a _ {\mu}} = \frac {m _ {\mu} m _ {\mathrm {p}} / (m _ {\mu} + m _ {\mathrm {p}})}{m _ {\mathrm {e}} m _ {\mathrm {p}} / (m _ {\mathrm {e}} + m _ {\mathrm {p}})} \approx \frac {m _ {\mu} m _ {\mathrm {p}} / (m _ {\mu} + m _ {\mathrm {p}})}{m _ {\mathrm {e}}} \\ = \frac {2 0 7}{1 + m _ {\mathrm {u}} / m _ {\mathrm {p}}} = \frac {2 0 7}{1 + 2 0 7 (9 . 1 1 \times 1 0 ^ {- 3 1} / 1 . 6 7 \times 1 0 ^ {- 2 7})} = \frac {2 0 7}{1 . 1 1} = 1 8 6. 4 8 6. \\ \Delta E = 5. 8 8 \times 1 0 ^ {- 6} \mathrm {e V} \left(\frac {m _ {\mathrm {e}}}{m _ {\mu}}\right) \left(\frac {a ^ {3}}{a _ {\mu} ^ {3}}\right) \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
= 5. 8 8 \times 1 0 ^ {- 6} \mathrm {e V} \left(\frac {1}{2 0 7}\right) (1 8 6. 4 8 6) ^ {3} = 0. 1 8 4 \mathrm {e V}.
$$

正电子偶素 质子 $g = 5 . 5 9$ 被正电子 $g = 2$ 所替代做代换 $m _ { \mathrm { p } }  m _ { \mathrm { e } } , a  a _ { + \mathrm { e } }$

$$
\frac {a}{a _ {+ \mathrm {e}}} \approx \frac {m _ {\mathrm {e}} m _ {\mathrm {e}} / (m _ {\mathrm {e}} + m _ {\mathrm {e}})}{m _ {\mathrm {e}}} = \frac {1}{2},
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} \Delta E = 5. 8 8 \times 1 0 ^ {- 6} \mathrm {e V} \left(\frac {g _ {\mathrm {e}}}{g _ {\mathrm {p}}}\right) \left(\frac {m _ {\mathrm {p}}}{m _ {\mathrm {e}}}\right) \left(\frac {a ^ {3}}{a _ {+ \mathrm {e}} ^ {3}}\right) \\ = 5. 8 8 \times 1 0 ^ {- 6} \mathrm {e V} \left(\frac {2}{5 . 5 9}\right) \left(\frac {1 . 6 7 \times 1 0 ^ {- 2 7}}{9 . 1 1 \times 1 0 ^ {- 3 1}}\right) \left(\frac {1}{2}\right) ^ {3} \\ = 4. 8 2 1 \times 1 0 ^ {- 4} \mathrm {e V}. \\ \end{array}
$$

反 $\mu$ 子素 质子 $g = 5 . 5 9$ 被 $\mu$ 子的 $g = 2$ 所替代，做代换 $m _ { \mathrm { p } }  m _ { \mu } , a  a _ { \mu }$

$$
\frac {a}{a _ {\mathrm {u}}} \approx \frac {m _ {\mathrm {e}} m _ {\mathrm {u}} / (m _ {\mathrm {e}} + m _ {\mathrm {u}})}{m _ {\mathrm {e}}} = \frac {2 0 7}{2 0 8},
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} \Delta E = 5. 8 8 \times 1 0 ^ {- 6} \mathrm {e V} \left(\frac {g _ {\mu}}{g _ {\mathrm {p}}}\right) \left(\frac {m _ {\mathrm {p}}}{m _ {\mu}}\right) \left(\frac {a ^ {3}}{a _ {\mu} ^ {3}}\right) \\ = 5. 8 8 \times 1 0 ^ {- 6} \mathrm {e V} \left(\frac {2}{5 . 5 9}\right) \left(\frac {1 . 6 7 \times 1 0 ^ {- 2 7}}{2 0 7 \times 9 . 1 1 \times 1 0 ^ {- 3 1}}\right) \left(\frac {2 0 7}{2 0 8}\right) ^ {3} \\ = 1. 8 3 6 \times 1 0 ^ {- 5} \mathrm {e V}. \\ \end{array}
$$

# 补充习题
